race.description: Hoist Torque Australia 2yo Pearl Classic Pace (G1)
race.comment: HEZ THE BOSS (1) added to the picket fence last start when he scored against softer opposition over 2130m at this track by 10 metres. Drawn well so has a great chance to score again. IDEAL WHISPER (4) was an impressive winner last start over 2130m at this track, getting home by 6 metres. Should enjoy a lovely run and looks hard to beat again. IGNITE THE FURNACE (9) found one better last start over 2130m at this track, beaten 6 metres. Looms as a serious challenger, so stick with him on an each-way basis. RIP TIDE (10) returned from a break last start and finished in the money over 2130m at this venue. Can feature.
